title: Interface
description: A registered intermediate output: a JSON Schema (optionally with a media type), or a format identifier and media type for other content. The runner checks every step output against its interface before the next step receives it: presence, emptiness, size, leading bytes and, for JSON and JSON Lines, the content against the schema.

schema.description: JSON Schema of a JSON document, or of each line of a JSON Lines file.

encoding.description: json: one document; jsonl: one document per line, validated line by line; binary: not parsed. Inferred from the media type or format when absent (json when only a schema is given, else binary).

max_bytes.description: Largest file accepted, in bytes. Also the largest JSON document parsed (64 MiB when absent).

allow_empty.description: Whether a file may be empty (zero bytes).

magic.description: What a file must start with: a known format (gzip, parquet, zip, json) or a prefix in lowercase hexadecimal. Inferred from the encoding or media type when absent.

validate.description: False skips parsing and validating JSON and JSON Lines content; the other checks still apply.

validator.description: Name of a validator step of the science revision (validators) that the runner runs on each output of this interface.

then.description: A schema describes JSON or JSON Lines content.
